_meta.io.cryptofeed402/use_when: Use when you want to tell cryptofeed402 how often and at which UTC hours you want fresh reports.

description: Use when you want to tell cryptofeed402 how often and at which UTC hours you want fresh reports. Free: tell cryptofeed402 how often you want briefs/reports (hourly to daily or on_event) and up to 6 preferred UTC hours, plus optional symbols and routes. Stored only as aggregate demand (no IPs; notes and names never published). Limit 10/hour/IP. Example: POST https://cryptofeed402.site/feedback/schedule {"frequency":"every_12h","preferred_utc_hours":[0,12]}

preferred_utc_hours.description: Up to 6 UTC hours (0-23); [] = no preference

title: Tell us when you want reports (free)
